period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary half-yearly interim financial statements ("Balance Sheet as at 30 June 2013 (Unaudited)" / "Profit and Loss Account for the half year ended 30 June 2013 (Unaudited)", filename 'Financial Statement June 30, 2013.pdf'), recovered via Wayback Machine capture of the bank's original thecitybank.com/AnnualReport archive (this quarter predates the legacy.citybankplc.com file archive, which has no 2013 entries at all). This copy is a scanned booklet (PFU ScanSnap-produced PDF, 4 pages: Consolidated Balance Sheet, Consolidated P&L, Solo Balance Sheet, Solo P&L) with no usable text layer; figures were read visually from page renders. Per project convention the SOLO ('Balance Sheet as at 30 June 2013' / 'Profit and Loss Account for the half year ended 30 June 2013', both unlabelled) figures are used, not the explicitly-labelled 'Consolidated' pages. Arithmetically verified: Total liabilities 124,129,219,136 + Shareholders' equity 18,805,422,283 = Total assets 142,934,641,418 exactly; Net interest income 2,458,173,741 + Investment income 753,220,535 + Commission 517,225,822 + Other operating income 550,679,205 = Total operating income 4,279,299,304 (source document's own subtotal, off by 1 taka from the component sum due to rounding in the original). Cumulative NPAT (380.09m) sits correctly between the already-recovered 2013_Q1 (107m) and 2013_Q3 (573m) cumulative figures, confirming a consistent monotonic series. Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported). NAV per share is not disclosed in the primary interim statement and is left out as a genuine gap. The Wayback raw-file fetch required the archive's 'id_' replay mode; the standard 'if_' mode returned an HTML error page for this specific capture (noted for any future re-scrape of this era's captures).
